text: Before legal requirements can be evaluated automatically against a runtime's behavior, the runtime must produce a record of that behavior that survives the session and admits third-party interpretation, making durable provenance a precondition for the regulatory interface.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

abstract: Before legal requirements can be evaluated automatically against a runtime's behavior, the runtime must produce a record of that behavior which survives the session and admits third-party interpretation. Requirement 2 is therefore a precondition for the regulatory interface, not merely for debugging.
